# Riviera Recovery

> Riviera Recovery provides comprehensive sober living, mental health housing, and addiction treatment services across Los Angeles and West LA with gender-affirming and specialized residential programs.

Riviera Recovery operates multiple transitional living facilities and sober living homes in the Los Angeles area, offering evidence-based treatment including DBT, dual diagnosis care, and integrated mental health services. The organization serves young adults and provides specialized housing options including pet-friendly facilities and luxury residences.

## Core Programs & Services

- [Services Overview](https://rivierarecovery.com/services): Riviera Recovery's holistic programs including DBT and gender-specific facilities
- [Men's Recovery Home](https://rivierarecovery.com/services/mens-mental-health-housing): Men's recovery home with dual diagnosis and sober living in Los Angeles
- [Gender-Affirming Care](https://rivierarecovery.com/services/gender-affirming-care-in-los-angeles): Gender-affirming mental health and addiction treatment services in Los Angeles
- [Transitional Living Centers](https://rivierarecovery.com/transitional-living-centers-in-west-los-angeles): Riviera's transitional living centers for men and women in West LA
- [Luxury Sober Living](https://rivierarecovery.com/luxury-sober-living-in-los-angeles): Luxury sober living and transitional housing in Los Angeles by Riviera Recovery

## Residential Facilities

- [Vistawood House](https://rivierarecovery.com/sober-living-los-angeles/vistawood-house): Supportive mental health housing for young adults in LA
- [Pet-Friendly Mental Health Housing](https://rivierarecovery.com/pet-friendly-mental-health-housing): Pet-friendly mental health housing and pet therapy at Riviera Recovery
